1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = 800;
5: canvas.height = 200;
6: 
7: // Game settings
8: let speed = 2; // base scroll speed (pixels/frame)
9: const speedIncrement = 0.001; // accelerate over time
10: const gravity = 0.6;
11: const jumpStrength = -12;
12: 
13: // Player block
14: const player = {
15:   x: 50,
16:   y: canvas.height - 40,
17:   width: 30,
18:   height: 30,
19:   vy: 0,
20:   onGround: true,
21:   draw() {
22:     ctx.fillStyle = '#4A90E2';
23:     ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
24:   },
25:   update() {
26:     this.vy += gravity;
27:     this.y += this.vy;
28:     if (this.y + this.height >= canvas.height) {
29:       this.y = canvas.height - this.height;
30:       this.vy = 0;
31:       this.onGround = true;
32:     } else {
33:       this.onGround = false;
34:     }
35:   },
36:   jump() {
37:     if (this.onGround) {
38:       this.vy = jumpStrength;
39:       this.onGround = false;
40:     }
41:   }
42: };
43: 
44: // Spikes
45: const spikes = [];
46: const spikeWidth = 20;
47: const spikeHeight = 30;
48: let spikeTimer = 0;
49: const spikeInterval = 90; // frames between spikes (adjusted by speed)
50: 
51: function addSpike() {
52:   spikes.push({
53:     x: canvas.width,
54:     y: canvas.height - spikeHeight,
55:     width: spikeWidth,
56:     height: spikeHeight
57:   });
58: }
59: 
60: function updateSpikes() {
61:   for (let i = spikes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
62:     const s = spikes[i];
63:     s.x -= speed;
64:     if (s.x + s.width < 0) spikes.splice(i, 1);
65:   }
66: }
67: 
68: function drawSpikes() {
69:   ctx.fillStyle = '#D0021B';
70:   spikes.forEach(s => ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.width, s.height));
71: }
72: 
73: function checkCollision() {
74:   for (const s of spikes) {
75:     if (
76:       player.x < s.x + s.width &&
77:       player.x + player.width > s.x &&
78:       player.y < s.y + s.height &&
79:       player.y + player.height > s.y
80:     ) {
81:       return true;
82:     }
83:   }
84:   return false;
85: }
86: 
87: let gameOver = false;
88: function gameLoop() {
89:   if (gameOver) return;
90:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
91: 
92:   // Update speed gradually
93:   speed += speedIncrement;
94: 
95:   // Player update
96:   player.update();
97:   player.draw();
98: 
99:   // Spike handling
100:   spikeTimer++;
101:   if (spikeTimer > spikeInterval / speed) { // faster spikes as speed rises
102:     addSpike();
103:     spikeTimer = 0;
104:   }
105:   updateSpikes();
106:   drawSpikes();
107: 
108:   // Collision detection
109:   if (checkCollision()) {
110:     gameOver = true;
111:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
112:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
114:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
115:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
116:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
117:     return;
118:   }
119: 
120:   requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
121: }
122: 
123: // Input handling
124: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
125:   if (e.code === 'Space') {
126:     e.preventDefault();
127:     player.jump();
128:   }
129: });
130: 
131: // Start
132: requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
